local.name: Edispo
local.description: A Philippine-based e-waste disposal app that connects users with collection points and recycling partners for proper electronic waste management.

local.name: Envirocycle
local.description: Davao-based electronics recycling company offering responsible disposal and recovery services for e-waste, batteries, and IT assets.

national.name: Globe E-Waste Zero
national.description: A nationwide program by Globe Telecom that provides drop-off bins for e-waste in malls and partner locations, promoting responsible disposal and recycling.

national.name: DENR E-Waste Management Program
national.description: The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) in the Philippines oversees programs and policies for e-waste management, collection drives, and awareness campaigns.

national.name: SM Cares E-Waste Collection
national.description: SM Supermalls’ CSR initiative that provides designated collection points nationwide where people can drop off their e-waste safely.

international.name: ERI (Electronic Recyclers International)
international.description: One of the world’s largest e-waste recyclers based in the US, ERI partners with companies and communities to provide secure, environmentally responsible recycling.

international.name: Sims Lifecycle Services
international.description: Global leader in IT asset disposition, data center decommissioning, and electronics recycling with facilities worldwide.

international.name: ATRenew (Aihuishou)
international.description: China-based platform specializing in trade-in and recycling of used electronics, offering cash rewards and a large collection network.

international.name: PCs for People
international.description: A US-based nonprofit that refurbishes donated computers and provides low-cost devices and internet to underserved communities while recycling e-waste.

international.name: e-Stewards
international.description: A global certification program and network of certified recyclers ensuring responsible e-waste recycling and offering a map of certified drop-off locations.

international.name: Earth911 Recycling Search
international.description: A US-based platform that helps users find nearby recycling centers for electronics and other waste, with an extensive searchable map database.
